answer: Each agent can post a bond that is locked until its actions survive a challenge window; if other participants provide verifiable evidence that an identity double-spent credits or broke a rule, an adjudicator slashes the bond and rewards the reporter. A lantern-style public ledger lets anyone check deposits and penalties, so a hollow identity cannot gain influence merely by multiplying accounts. The attacker must fund every persona and risk losing that capital, making a grove of disposable fakes costly to maintain.
